mn124:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā bakkulo rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
mn124:2.1: atha kho acelo kassapo āyasmato bakkulassa purāṇagihisahāyo yenāyasmā bakkulo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā bakkulena saddhiṃ sammodi
mn124:2.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho acelo kassapo āyasmantaṃ bakkulaṃ etadavoca
mn124:3.3: imehi pana te āvuso bakkula asītiyā vassehi katikkhattuṃ methuno dhammo paṭisevitoti.
mn124:3.4: na kho maṃ āvuso kassapa evaṃ pucchitabbaṃ
mn124:3.5: imehi pana te āvuso bakkula asītiyā vassehi katikkhattuṃ methuno dhammo paṭisevitoti
mn124:3.6: evañca kho maṃ āvuso kassapa pucchitabbaṃ
mn124:3.7: imehi pana te āvuso bakkula asītiyā vassehi katikkhattuṃ kāmasaññā uppannapubbāti.
mn124:3.9: asīti me āvuso vassāni pabbajitassa nābhijānāmi kāmasaññaṃ uppannapubbanti.
mn124:3.10: yampāyasmā bakkulo asītiyā vassehi nābhijānāti kāmasaññaṃ uppannapubbaṃ idampi mayaṃ āyasmato bakkulassa acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhārema.

mn124:30-36.8: yampāyasmā bakkulo asītiyā vassehi nābhijānāmi seyyaṃ kappetā idampi mayaṃ āyasmato bakkulassa acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhārema.
mn124:37.1: asīti me āvuso vassāni pabbajitassa nābhijānāmi gāmantasenāsane vassaṃ upagantā.
mn124:37.2: yampāyasmā bakkulo asītiyā vassehi nābhijānāti gāmantasenāsane vassaṃ upagantā idampi mayaṃ āyasmato bakkulassa acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhārema.
mn124:38.1: sattāhameva kho ahaṃ āvuso sāraṇo raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjiṃ
mn124:38.3: yampāyasmā bakkulo sattāhameva sāraṇo raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ bhuñji atha aṭṭhamiyaṃ aññā udapādi idampi mayaṃ āyasmato bakkulassa acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhārema.
mn124:39.1: labheyyāhaṃ āvuso bakkula imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
mn124:39.2: alattha kho acelo kassapo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ.
mn124:39.3: acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā kassapo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
mn124:39.4: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
mn124:39.5: aññataro kho panāyasmā kassapo arahataṃ ahosi.
mn124:40.1: atha kho āyasmā bakkulo aparena samayena apāpuraṇaṃ ādāya vihārena vihāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā evamāha
mn124:40.2: abhikkamathāyasmanto abhikkamathāyasmanto ajja me parinibbānaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn124:40.3: yampāyasmā bakkulo apāpuraṇaṃ ādāya vihārena vihāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā evamāha abhikkamathāyasmanto abhikkamathāyasmanto ajja me parinibbānaṃ bhavissatīti idampi mayaṃ āyasmato bakkulassa acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremāti. atha kho
mn124:41.1: āyasmā bakkulo majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa nisinnako parinibbāyi.
mn124:41.2: yampāyasmā bakkulo majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa nisinnako parinibbāyi idampi mayaṃ āyasmato bakkulassa acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremāti.
